Summarize sequential cohort attrition

Source: R/attrition.R
nis_attrition.Rd

Applies logical criteria cumulatively and reports remaining and dropped discharge counts at each step. Criteria are evaluated in order; NA values are treated as excluded, matching dplyr::filter(). The summary is aggregated lazily for Arrow queries and returned as a collected tibble. Missing weights contribute zero to weighted totals.

Usage

nis_attrition(.data, ..., by_year = FALSE, weight_var = "DISCWT")

Arguments

.data

A data frame or lazy Arrow query.

...

Named logical expressions applied cumulatively. Unnamed expressions use their deparsed text as the criterion label.

by_year

If TRUE, calculate each step within YEAR.

weight_var

Name of the discharge weight column. Defaults to "DISCWT".

Value

A tibble with one initial row (step = 0) and one row per criterion. When by_year = TRUE, YEAR is the first column.

See also

Defining cohorts.

Other cohort-definition: nis_audit_code_transition(), nis_ccsr_codes(), nis_dx_sensitivity(), nis_flag_dx(), nis_flag_dx_position(), nis_flag_pr(), nis_flag_pr_timing(), nis_prday_completeness()

Examples

toy_nis <- dplyr::tibble(
  AGE = c(16, 45, 60, 72, 55),
  ELECTIVE = c(1, 1, 0, 1, 1),
  DISCWT = c(5.0, 5.2, 4.8, 5.1, 5.0),
  YEAR = rep(2020L, 5)
)
nis_attrition(toy_nis, adult = AGE >= 18, elective = ELECTIVE == 1)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 7
#>    step criterion      n_unweighted n_dropped_unweighted n_weighted
#>   <int> <chr>                 <int>                <int>      <dbl>
#> 1     0 All discharges            5                    0       25.1
#> 2     1 adult                     4                    1       20.1
#> 3     2 elective                  3                    1       15.3
#> # ℹ 2 more variables: n_dropped_weighted <dbl>, pct_retained <dbl>
